# 1.37.0: the agent gets a browser, Windows tools and a voice

The agent gets its own browser and new Windows tools, and the chat gets a voice.

## Agent browser

- The agent has its own browser: a separate window with its own profile and sign-ins, apart from your Edge. It opens sites, reads pages, clicks and fills in forms through the page itself, which is far more reliable than the mouse on large pages.
- It never types passwords. When a site needs a sign-in or a check, the window shows what to do and a **Done** button.
- It knows when to search the web, when to read one page, when to act on a site and when to work in program windows. To show you a page, it opens it in your own browser.
- Pages it has read stay in its memory in short form, so it no longer goes round in circles between a list and its items. A step that failed twice is tried another way.
- Page dialogs ("Leave site?", messages, confirmations) are answered by the browser itself and no longer freeze the agent.
- Downloads go to Downloads through the same allowlist as before.
- Turn it on in **Settings → Security**. It is off by default and never arrives from a data archive.

## Windows tools

The agent can now look into and fix:

- **Sound**: devices, the default device, volume per program, restarting the audio services.
- **Bluetooth**: paired devices with battery level, turning the radio on and off, forgetting a device.
- **Network quality**: loss, delay and jitter to the router, DNS and the internet, the Wi-Fi signal, and the likely culprit.
- **Slowdowns that come and go**: a recording of the load over several minutes, with the processes behind every peak.
- **Permissions**: why access to a file, folder or registry key is denied, and changing the owner and rights with a rollback snapshot.
- **Environment variables and PATH**: duplicates, missing folders, clean-up, with rollback.
- **Files in use**: which program holds a file open, and asking it to close.
- **Power**: power plans, what keeps the PC awake or woke it up, battery wear.
- **Printing**: stuck jobs, the queue, the print spooler, the default printer.
- **Network sharing**: why computers or shared folders are not seen, network drives.
- **Store apps**: listing, removing and resetting them.

Every change asks you first, as before.

## Chat

- **Temporary chat**: the incognito button in the top right corner of an empty chat. Such a chat is never saved, searched, archived or backed up. **Settings → Security → Privacy** decides whether it lives until the app closes or disappears as soon as you leave it.
- **Branch into a new chat**: a button under every answer starts a new chat with the conversation up to that answer.
- The chat can write to agents from earlier answers too. **Settings → Models → Agent** sets how long they stay: until the answer ends, while the app is open, or saved in the chat.
- While the open chat is answering, the **To the end of the chat** button shows three playful dots.
- The answer cost estimate next to the context ring is gone; the chat total has a new icon.

## Auto and the agent

- **Auto** has a third model for replies that need no thinking at all, in the new **Fast tasks** row. Learning, explaining and solving stay on the light model or above, and questions where accuracy matters (science, analysis, proofs, debugging) go to the heavy model much more often.
- "Do it quickly" in your message now starts the fast agent right away. Asking an agent that is already fast to hurry no longer restarts it.
- In the normal mode the agent no longer stops to ask about steps you asked for, and the safety check sees what is actually being typed and sent.

## Models

- **Speed** for models that have it, next to the reasoning level: Economy, Standard, Fast and Ultrafast for OpenAI, fast mode for Claude Opus, and the same through OpenRouter.
- **Nitro** variants of OpenRouter models: turn on the Nitro chip in the model list.
- Models that cannot turn reasoning off no longer offer the switch and show their lowest level. Models that can, now really do.
- New defaults, set once for everyone, with OpenRouter first (without an OpenRouter key they move to the provider of your key): Claude Haiku 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5 for the chat and the agent, MiniMax M3.1 Flash for fast tasks, DeepSeek V4 Flash for chat titles, Grok 4.3 for bypass. Your SynGuard switch and web search choice are kept.

## Voice

- **Read aloud**: the speaker button under an answer. Windows reads it, or a speech model of Venice or OpenRouter. **Auto** takes ElevenLabs with an OpenRouter key and the Windows voice without one.
- **Voice input in any language**: with a Venice or OpenRouter key, recognition runs in the cloud, so Russian and other languages Windows cannot recognize just work. A line under **Recognition** says what listens right now.
- While recording, the microphone button lights up and five dots move with your voice.
- **Recordings and video** (MP3, M4A, WAV, MP4, MOV and more) are transcribed as soon as you attach them and arrive as text with time marks.

## Documents and tables

- The chat makes **PowerPoint** presentations and edits existing ones slide by slide, keeping their layouts and look.
- Ask about a **CSV or Excel** table and the program filters, groups and totals every row itself.
- **Charts** appear right in the answer, in your theme's colors, and real Excel charts can be added to a workbook.
- Text in pictures and scanned PDFs is read on this PC with the recognition built into Windows.

## Quick access

- **Ctrl+Shift+P**: one search over actions, settings, recipes, slash commands and chats.
- **Win+Shift+Q**: a small window over any app for a quick question. It is not saved unless you open it in the chat.
- A shortcut from any app takes a screenshot of an area and attaches it to the chat. Set it in **Settings → General → Keyboard shortcuts**.

## Security and privacy

- **Autostart audit**: ask the agent, and it checks services, scheduled tasks, Run keys, startup folders, WMI subscriptions and browser extensions, listing only the risky ones.
- Every line of the audit log carries the hash of the line before it, and the journal shows whether the chain is intact. Each action is also copied to the Windows Application log.
- **OpenRouter without data retention**: send requests only to providers that neither store them nor train on them.
- The download allowlist can be switched off and back on.
- **Organizations** can set policies through the registry or the ADMX template attached to each release: read-only mode, tools turned off, allowed providers and models, no mouse control.

## Look and feel

- **GlueGray**: a new calm graphite dark theme.
- Dialogs, tooltips and panels sit on a darker surface of their own, with tighter spacing and smaller buttons. The question before a risky action is shorter.
- **PC health** opens as a panel under its button, with live CPU, memory and disk.
- The journal is more compact, folders in the sidebar are quieter, and tooltips with numbers are small tables.
- **What's new** has its own window: sections on the left, and the notes can be translated into your language by AI.

## Updates

- An update downloads only what changed since your version when a patch is available: about half the size. It is still installed only if it matches the release checksum.
- Releases come with winget manifests, so the program can be installed with `winget install Qvisono.AmarinAdminAI` once the package is accepted into the catalog.

## Rosa

- Rosa finishes what he says and says goodbye before he leaves.
- Thanks or rudeness meant for the assistant no longer reach him unless you call him by name.
- He is full for two or three hours after treats, not until midnight.
- Switching profiles brings the Rosa of that profile, or none if he is off there.

## Rolling back

Settings, keys and conversations from earlier versions are read as they are. Rolling back to 1.36 keeps your settings and chats. GlueGray shows there as the plain dark or light theme and comes back with 1.37.
